title: Thresholds and Learning in Adaptive Intrusion Detection: A Two-Capture Case Study — code and recorded evidence
description: Executable source, fitted initial states, full per-block reports and numerical summaries for a two-capture case study of threshold selection, calibration coverage and score adaptation under sparse delayed labels. Includes 55 initial-extension cells and diagnostic sets A/B/C with 120/10/10 cells; thirty A cells repeat earlier trajectories. Set C evaluates identical all-label calibration, matched update timing and occurrence-weighted normal-role coverage. Raw traffic is not redistributed. Historical Windows evidence and Linux reconstructions are distinguished. Seeds quantify variation conditional on each previously inspected capture.
